title: Minimum jump velocity
description: Essential Criteria: The response must calculate the minimum horizontal velocity from point A as 8 m/s using projectile motion equations.

title: Swing speed at bottom
description: Essential Criteria: The response must calculate the speed at the lowest point of the swing as 9 m/s using conservation of mechanical energy.

title: Vine force magnitude
description: Essential Criteria: The response must calculate the magnitude of the force exerted by the vine at the lowest point as 216 N.

title: Projectile motion setup
description: Important Criteria: The solution must correctly set up the projectile motion equations for the jump from A, relating fall time to h₁ and horizontal distance to x₁.

title: Energy conservation application
description: Important Criteria: The solution must apply conservation of mechanical energy correctly for the swing, equating potential energy loss (M+m)gh₂ to kinetic energy gain.

title: Circular motion force balance
description: Important Criteria: The solution must set up Newton's second law for circular motion at the lowest point, with centripetal force equal to T - (M+m)g.

title: Vine length calculation
description: Important Criteria: The solution must determine the vine length L = 10 m using the Pythagorean theorem with given geometry (L-h₂, x₂).

title: Mass combination handling
description: Optional Criteria: The solution should correctly combine masses M and m after the large monkey picks up the small monkey for swing calculations.

title: Sign error in force equation
description: Pitfall Criteria: Deduct points if the centripetal force equation incorrectly writes (M+m)g - T = mv²/L instead of T - (M+m)g = mv²/L.

title: Unit inconsistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: Deduct points if calculations mix inconsistent units or omit units in final answers.
